Strawberry Nutella Brownies 🍓🤎 Perfect brownies for summer!  (recipe makes an 8x8 pan) Ingredients:  10 tbsp (140g) unsalted butter, melted 1 cup (200g) granulated sugar ¼ cup (50g) brown sugar, packed  2 eggs, room temp 1 tsp vanilla extract ½ cup + 2 tbsp (56g) unsweetened cocoa powder ½ tsp salt 1 tbsp (13g) vegetable oil ½ cup (63g) all purpose flour, spooned & leveled or weighed (don’t pack it in) ¾ cup chocolate chips 190g (~⅔ cup) Nutella  Topping: Strawberry slices, patted dry (as many as you want/enough to cover the top) Nutella (to spread over the top & drizzle)  Instructions: Line an 8x8 pan with parchment paper. Spread the nutella onto the parchment into a thin, even square the size of the pan. Freeze for at least 30 minutes or until frozen solid. Preheat oven to 325°F and line/grease an 8x8 pan with parchment. In a large bowl, whisk melted butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until smooth. Add eggs and vanilla, then whisk vigorously for 1-2 minutes. Stir in cocoa powder and salt until fully combined. Mix in oil, then gently fold in the flour until just combined (don’t over mix). Fold in chocolate chips. Spread half the batter into the greased pan. Place the frozen nutella sheet on top of it. Then, spread the remaining batter over it to cover the nutella layer completely. Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until a toothpick near the center comes out with no wet batter. It should just come out with a little nutella & slightly moist crumbs. Let the brownies cool completely. Spread a thin layer of nutella over the cooled brownies, add strawberry slices (patted dry) all over the top, and drizzle with more nutella.  Best enjoyed fresh!  #bakingrecipe #brownies #chocolatestrawberries #nutella #recipe

Strawberry Pull-Apart Bread 🍓✨ Dough: 3 cups all-purpose flour (360g) 5 tbsp melted butter (71g) 3 tbsp granulated sugar (38g) 1 tsp salt (6g) 2¼ tsp active dry yeast (7g) 1 large egg (50g) ¾ cup warm milk (180g) 1 tsp vanilla extract Simple Glaze: 1 cup powdered sugar (120g) 1–2 tbsp milk (15–30g) 1 tbsp melted butter (14g) Splash of vanilla extract Strawberry Compote Ingredients:  300g strawberries (about 2 cups, chopped) 75–90g granulated sugar (6–7 tbsp) 1 tbsp lemon juice 10–12g cornstarch (1–1½ tbsp) 30g water (2 tbsp) Instructions: In a bowl, mix warm milk, sugar, and yeast and let sit for 8–10 minutes until foamy, then add the egg, melted butter, and vanilla and mix until combined; add in the flour and salt and knead for about 8–10 minutes until smooth, then cover and let rise for 1 hour or until doubled. Meanwhile, make the strawberry compote by cooking strawberries, sugar, and lemon juice over medium heat until soft and juicy (about 5–7 minutes), lightly mash, then stir in the cornstarch mixed with water and cook until thickened, then let cool completely. Roll the dough into a rectangle, spread the strawberry compote evenly over the surface, cut into strips, stack them, and slice into pieces, then place upright into a greased loaf pan, cover and let rise for another 30 minutes before baking at 350°F (175°C) for 35–45 minutes until golden, then mix the glaze ingredients and drizzle over the warm bread. #breadmaking #strawberry #pullapartbread #baking #recipes

Strawberry Crunch Ice Cream Taco FULL RECIPE 👇🏿 #shorts #food #recipe  STRAWBERRY SHORTCAKE ICE CREAM TACOS Makes: About 6–8 tacos TOOLS NEEDED Waffle cone maker Mixing bowls Whisk Electric hand mixer Rubber spatula Measuring cups Measuring spoons Taco-forming rack or taco holders Baking sheet Parchment paper Microwave-safe bowl ──────────────────────────── WAFFLE TACO SHELLS Ingredients 2 large eggs 1/2 cup granulated sugar 4 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 1/2 cup all-purpose flour 1/4 teaspoon salt 2 tablespoons milk, as needed to thin the batter ──────────────────────────── STRAWBERRY ICE CREAM FILLING Ingredients 2 cups cold heavy whipping cream 3/4 cup sweetened condensed milk 1 teaspoon strawberry extract 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh strawberries 2–3 tablespoons strawberry drizzle 1/3 cup sliced strawberries 1/4 cup crushed dehydrated strawberries ──────────────────────────── STRAWBERRY CRUNCH Ingredients Golden OREO cookies, filling removed OREO cookies, filling removed Dehydrated strawberries, crushed ──────────────────────────── WHITE CHOCOLATE COATING Ingredients 8 ounces white chocolate 1 teaspoon coconut oil ──────────────────────────── INSTRUCTIONS Make the Waffle Taco Shells Preheat the waffle cone maker. In a mixing bowl, whisk the eggs and sugar until smooth. Add the melted butter and vanilla extract. Mix in the flour and salt until a smooth batter forms. Add a small amount of milk if needed to loosen the batter. Spoon the batter onto the waffle cone maker and cook until golden and crisp around the edges. While each waffle is still hot and flexible, carefully fold it into a taco shape. Place it in a taco holder or rack and allow it to cool completely. The shell will firm up as it cools. ──────────────────────────── Make the Strawberry Ice Cream Filling Add the cold heavy whipping cream to a mixing bowl. Whip with an electric hand mixer until stiff peaks form. Gently fold in the sweetened condensed milk and strawberry extract. Fold in the chopped strawberries, strawberry drizzle, sliced strawberries, and crushed dehydrated strawberries. Place the mixture in the freezer for about 1 hour to allow it to firm slightly before assembling the tacos. ──────────────────────────── Make the Strawberry Crunch Remove the cream filling from the Golden OREOs and OREOs. Crush the cookies into coarse crumbs. Add the crushed dehydrated strawberries. Mix until evenly combined. ──────────────────────────── Prepare the White Chocolate Add the white chocolate and coconut oil to a microwave-safe bowl. Microwave in short intervals, stirring between each interval, until completely melted and smooth. The coconut oil will thin the chocolate slightly so it is easier to spread. ──────────────────────────── Assemble the Strawberry Shortcake Tacos Spread or brush the melted white chocolate onto the waffle taco shells. Immediately coat the chocolate with the strawberry crunch mixture. Allow the chocolate to set. Fill each taco generously with the strawberry ice cream filling. Add additional sliced strawberries, strawberry drizzle, dehydrated strawberries, and strawberry crunch on top. Freeze until the filling is completely firm, then serve.

Ingredients: For the Beef Bulgogi: • 24 oz ribeye, thinly sliced • ⅓ cup soy sauce • 1 tbsp mirin • 2 tbsp brown sugar • 1 tbsp honey • 1 tbsp toasted sesame oil • 4 garlic cloves, minced • 1 tsp fresh ginger, grated • ½ tsp black pepper • ½ yellow onion, thinly sliced • 2 green onions, sliced • Neutral oil, for cooking • Sesame seeds, for garnish For the Spicy Cucumber Salad: • 1 English cucumber, thinly sliced • ½ tsp salt • 1 tbsp gochujang • 1 tbsp rice vinegar • 1 tsp soy sauce • 1 tsp sugar • 1 tsp toasted sesame oil • 1 garlic clove, minced • 1 tsp sesame seeds For serving: • Steamed white rice Directions: 1. Mix the soy sauce, mirin, brown sugar, honey, sesame oil, garlic, ginger, and black pepper. Add the sliced ribeye, yellow onion, and green onions and toss until coated. Let marinate while you prep everything else. 2. Toss the sliced cucumber with salt and let sit for about 10 minutes to draw out the moisture. Drain and pat dry. 3. Mix the gochujang, rice vinegar, soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, and garlic. Toss with the cucumbers and finish with sesame seeds. 4. While the beef marinates and cucumbers sit, cook your rice. 5. Heat a large skillet or wok over high heat with a little neutral oil. Cook the beef in batches for about 2–3 minutes, tossing occasionally, until caramelized and cooked through. 6. Build your bowls with warm rice, beef bulgogi, and the spicy cucumber salad. Finish with sesame seeds and enjoy! Recipe Name Bacon-Wrapped Cheesy Stuffed Meatloaf Ingredients 1. 2 pounds ground beef 2. 1 small yellow onion, finely diced 3. 3 cloves garlic, minced 4. 1 cup breadcrumbs 5. 1/2 cup milk 6. 1 large egg 7. 1 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce 8. 1 teaspoon salt 9. 1 teaspoon black pepper 10. 1 teaspoon smoked paprika 11. 1 teaspoon garlic powder 12. 1/2 teaspoon onion powder 13. 8 slices cheddar cheese 14. 1 cup shredded Monterey Jack cheese 15. 12–14 slices bacon 16. 1/2 cup ketchup 17. 2 tablespoons brown sugar 18. 1 tablespoon yellow mustard 19. 1 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce 20. 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley Recipe 1. Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C). 2. Line a large baking sheet or loaf pan with parchment paper. 3. Combine the breadcrumbs and milk in a bowl and let them sit for 2–3 minutes. 4. Add the ground beef, onion, garlic, egg, Worcestershire sauce, salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, garlic powder, and onion powder. 5. Gently mix until all ingredients are evenly incorporated without overworking the meat. 6. Place the beef mixture onto parchment paper and shape it into a large rectangle. 7. Arrange the cheddar cheese slices down the center, leaving space around the edges. 8. Sprinkle the shredded Monterey Jack cheese evenly over the cheddar. 9. Carefully fold the meat mixture around the cheese and pinch the seams closed completely. 10. Shape the stuffed meat into a firm loaf, making sure no cheese is exposed through the sides. 11. Arrange the bacon slices on a clean surface, slightly overlapping each slice. 12. Place the meatloaf over the bacon and wrap the bacon tightly around the entire loaf. 13. Place the bacon-wrapped meatloaf seam-side down on the prepared baking sheet. 14. Mix the ketchup, brown sugar, mustard, and Worcestershire sauce to make the glaze. 15. Brush half of the glaze over the bacon-covered meatloaf. 16. Bake for 45 minutes. 17. Remove the meatloaf and brush generously with the remaining glaze. 18. Return it to the oven and continue baking for 20–30 minutes, until the center reaches a safe internal temperature of 160°F (71°C). 19. Broil for 1–2 minutes at the end if you want the bacon extra crisp and caramelized, watching carefully. 20. Remove from the oven and let the meatloaf rest for 10–15 minutes before slicing. 21.
